situation_headline: 85CL at 52-week high; 50CL forecast to collapse 51% over 6 months.
situation_paragraphs: Beef manufacturing cuts firmed on May 21 with 85CL Lean Ground Beef at $410.18/cwt (+3.08% day-over-day), sitting at or near its 52-week high. 50CL Fat Trim rose to $190.37/cwt (+1.79%), while Insides Combo ($517.40/cwt) and Flats & Eyes Combo ($505.57/cwt) were essentially flat. Choice Beef Cutout softened slightly to $391.48/cwt (-$2.14/cwt), suggesting some downstream demand resistance despite lean trim strength.

The 6-month outlook is bearish for manufacturing trims: the 85CL 26-week P50 forecast is $391.05/cwt (-4.7% from today's anchor), and 50CL is projected to drop sharply to $92.74/cwt (-51.3%), reflecting typical seasonal fat trim devaluation. Combo cuts are expected to ease modestly — Insides to $504.15/cwt (-2.6%) and Flats & Eyes to $496.76/cwt (-1.7%). With 85CL near its annual peak, forward-buying lean trim now at current prices carries meaningful downside risk.

immediate: Avoid locking in 85CL at current $410/cwt — at 52-week high with -4.7% forecast decline over 6 months
Review 50CL contract exposure: spot at $190/cwt, P50 forecast $92/cwt — avoid new long positions
Evaluate combo cut contracts (Insides $517, Flats $506) for short-term needs at stable current pricing
Confirm Choice Cutout softening ($391.48, -$2.14) does not signal broader demand pullback in retail
near_term: Set price alerts at 85CL $390/cwt to re-evaluate forward buys as forecast correction begins
Monitor 50CL weekly — if spot begins tracking toward $150/cwt, accelerate any needed volume ahead of deeper decline
Assess pork ham pricing (Insides $133.99, Knuckles $137.02) relative to beef combos for formulation substitution opportunities
Re-run USDA data pull when MPR API recovers to refresh forecasts with latest report data
strategic: With 85CL at cycle peak, model 6-month procurement scenarios using $391/cwt P50 as planning baseline
Review pork carcass cutout ($95.64/cwt) trends — current levels may support beef-to-pork mix shifts if beef prices hold elevated
Prepare contract framework for 85CL and Insides forward buys targeting Q4 entry if prices correct per forecast
